# abcjs (vendored)

Draws the sheet music in Sound Space (`assets/apps/sound-space.html`, the Sheet music window).
Loaded only when that window first opens; never from a CDN at runtime.

- Package: abcjs **6.4.4** (basic build, minified)
- File: `abcjs-basic-min.js`, unchanged from the package
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/abcjs@6.4.4/dist/abcjs-basic-min.js
- SHA-256: `1f060d3568b8f49c0f22b7eaa98f8eb9e34a0e83c2dc14bc730d572a320e4c69`
  (base64 `HwYNNWi49JwPIrfqqY+OueNKDoPC3BS8cw1XKjIOTGk=`, matching jsDelivr's file listing for abcjs@6.4.4)

- License: MIT, copied from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/abcjs@6.4.4/LICENSE.md into `LICENSE`
- Fetched: 2026-11-14

To update: download the new `dist/abcjs-basic-min.js` and `LICENSE.md` for the exact version, check the header's
version, update this file, and bump `CACHE_VERSION` in `sw.js` at ship (the file is cached cache-first).
